security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives caused by TypeScript template literal syntax, Markdown code fences, sample URLs, and words such as any or avoid. Confirmed risks are limited to external command guidance, the optional diagnostic script using shell=True, and a recursive cache deletion command. No prompt-injection text or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The diagnostic helper executes shell command strings with shell=True.
remediation.suggestion: Replace shell=True calls with argument arrays, allowlist supported commands, and require user confirmation before running the helper.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends npm, npx, node, grep, and debugger commands in the user workspace.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before execution, prefer existing project scripts after reading package.json, and avoid npx downloads without confirmation.

remediation.issue: Cache cleanup guidance uses rm -rf on hidden TypeScript cache files.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact paths before deletion, ask for confirmation, and prefer tool-specific clean commands when available.

content.user_title: Improve TypeScript Code With Expert Guidance
content.value_statement: TypeScript projects often fail from weak types, slow builds, and confusing module behavior. This skill gives focused guidance for safer code, faster diagnostics, and cleaner migrations.
actual_capabilities: Reviews TypeScript and JavaScript project setup, tsconfig options, and dependency tooling.
Explains advanced types, branded types, mapped types, conditional types, and template literal types.
Guides strict-mode adoption, JavaScript migration, and safer replacement of any types.
Diagnoses type-check performance, module resolution issues, and monorepo configuration problems.
Suggests validation commands such as type checks, tests, and targeted build checks.
Provides TypeScript-specific code review criteria for type safety, modules, and error handling.
limitations: It needs project files or error messages to give precise recommendations.
It is not a replacement for dedicated bundler or compiler-internals expertise.
Suggested shell commands should be reviewed before execution in sensitive repositories.
It cannot guarantee runtime behavior from type information alone.

use_cases.title: Fix Type Errors
use_cases.description: Turn confusing compiler messages into prioritized fixes and safer type patterns.

use_cases.title: Plan TypeScript Migration
use_cases.description: Move JavaScript code toward strict TypeScript with staged checks and practical tooling.

use_cases.title: Improve Monorepo Tooling
use_cases.description: Assess tsconfig references, module resolution, build speed, and testing strategy across packages.

prompt_templates.title: Explain This Type Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain this TypeScript error in simple terms. Identify the likely cause, show the safest fix, and note any tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Strengthen Type Safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this TypeScript file for unsafe any types, excessive assertions, missing narrowing, and weak API boundaries. Prioritize fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Build Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this TypeScript project for slow type checking. Review tsconfig, package tooling, monorepo structure, and likely performance bottlenecks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Type-Level API
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a type-safe API for this use case. Include the type model, ergonomic constraints, failure modes, and how to test the types.

output_examples.input: A developer shares several TypeScript compiler errors after enabling strict mode.
output: A ranked diagnosis of the strict-mode failures.
Recommended fixes that preserve runtime behavior.
A short validation plan using type checks and focused tests.

output_examples.input: A team asks why type checking became slow in a large monorepo.
output: A likely bottleneck list covering project references, library checks, unions, and recursive types.
Concrete configuration changes to test first.
A measurement plan for comparing before and after results.

output_examples.input: A library author wants a safer API for identifiers and domain primitives.
output: A domain model using branded types and explicit boundaries.
Guidance on where runtime validation is still required.
Type testing suggestions for public API contracts.

best_practices: Share the relevant tsconfig, package scripts, error output, and affected files before asking for diagnosis.
Validate suggested changes with type checks, tests, and builds that match the project workflow.
Use the skill for design review before adding complex generic or mapped types to shared APIs.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to rewrite large projects without first defining migration stages and validation gates.
Do not run suggested shell commands in sensitive repositories without reviewing their effect.
Do not use advanced type patterns when a simple interface or explicit function would be clearer.

faq.question: Can this skill fix TypeScript compiler errors?
faq.answer: Yes. It can explain errors, identify likely causes, and suggest safer changes when given the relevant code and output.

faq.question: Does it support JavaScript to TypeScript migration?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides staged migration guidance, strictness planning, and tooling suggestions for gradual adoption.

faq.question: Can it help with slow type checking?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review configuration, type complexity, project references, and diagnostic output to find likely bottlenecks.

faq.question: Is it only for advanced TypeScript users?
faq.answer: No. It can explain basic compiler errors and also handle advanced type-level design.

faq.question: Will it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill suggests diagnostic commands, but users should review and approve commands before execution.

faq.question: When should I use a different expert?
faq.answer: Use a specialized bundler, module-system, or compiler-internals expert for deep tool implementation problems.
